Jika Anda tidak membayar, Anda tidak dapat memperpanjang izin tinggal Anda.

answers.answer:
To be eligible for the Global Nanum scholarship, you need a grade point average (GPA) of 3.35 or higher from the previous semester and you must have completed at least 12 credit hours. The scholarship amount is 1,150,000 won.

The application deadline is 2026-12-09.
